summary: The exact-head gate is not green. Tidy, the normal-clone root check with only the authorized Antora-specific site-link exclusion, and full-distribution packaging passed. A packaged browser flow verified same-origin Basic Auth header propagation, successful GET /api/collections, return navigation, and logout/relogin refresh under production CSP; a separate controlled cross-origin request carried neither Authorization nor X-Requested-With. However, the focused and combined Selenium runs failed before reaching the target request, and the unchanged revised test on the original parent head timed out at the same selector before the request. That parent replay is not behavioral fail-before proof.
